Seen 1.1.3 adds a visible Web/Desktop coverage note to both viewing-receipt panels and updates the plugin description and English/Russian documentation.

- Receipts are collected only by Web/Desktop. Native iOS/Android views are not collected by this version because those clients do not execute the plugin's webapp component.
- Backend sources, both Linux server binaries, dependencies, receipt storage and viewport rules are unchanged from 1.1.2.
- Experimental channel-read/mobile fallback is excluded. Possible future mobile indicators are a separate investigation and are not included in this release.

Install `ru.internal.mattermost.seen-1.1.3.tar.gz` as an update of the same plugin ID through System Console. Target: Mattermost 11.10.x, minimum 11.10.0; Linux amd64/arm64. Back up the previous package/settings, coordinate app nodes and reload Web/Desktop clients. The source ZIP is not an installer. No system database migration is required. See the packaged `README.ru.md` and `docs/release-1.1.3.md` for installation and rollback.

CI gates publication on frontend format/lint/typecheck/unit/build, Go race/vet, mock-browser smoke, source and packaged-binary vulnerability scans, module integrity, npm audit and package validation. The installer must match the exact SHA256 of the prepared 1.1.3 package. The source ZIP and validation report identify the publication commit and CI run.

This is a public pre-release for test-environment acceptance, consistent with the packaged documentation. Live Mattermost gateway/functional, HA/failover and load acceptance remain NOT RUN. Mock-browser and automated checks do not establish production or HA acceptance. Viewed means the plugin's observation marker entered the viewport under its dwell/focus rules; it is not proof that a person read the message.

Assets: install tar.gz, exact-commit source ZIP, `release-validation-1.1.3.json` and `SHA256SUMS-1.1.3-github.txt`. Verify all three data files with `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS-1.1.3-github.txt`.

Portions of this project were generated or refactored with assistance from OpenAI Codex.
